# anthropic_skills (Data Source)

Lists skills visible to the workspace: custom uploads and Anthropic-published skills.

~> The Managed Agents API is in beta. This resource needs `api_key` (a regular workspace API key, not an Admin key) and `workspace_id` when the key can reach more than one workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_skills" "custom" {
  source = "custom"
}

output "custom_skill_ids" {
  value = data.anthropic_skills.custom.skills[*].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `source` (String) Filter by `custom` or `anthropic`.

### Read-Only

- `skills` (Attributes List) Skills. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--skills))

<a id="nestedatt--skills"></a>
### Nested Schema for `skills`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `display_name` (String) Display label.
- `id` (String) Skill id.
- `latest_version_id` (String) Newest version id (what `latest` resolves to).
- `source_type` (String) `custom`, `anthropic`, `anthropic_example` or `plugin`.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
